projectMappingSql: SELECT source.id AS old_id,target.id AS new_id FROM legacy.managed_projects source JOIN main.managed_projects target ON CASE WHEN substr(source.path,1,8)='\\?\UNC\' THEN '\\'||substr(source.path,9) WHEN substr(source.path,1,4)='\\?\' THEN substr(source.path,5) ELSE source.path END=target.path WHERE source.id<>target.id
normalizeProjectsSql: UPDATE managed_projects SET path=CASE WHEN substr(path,1,8)='\\?\UNC\' THEN '\\'||substr(path,9) WHEN substr(path,1,4)='\\?\' THEN substr(path,5) ELSE path END WHERE substr(path,1,4)='\\?\';
